name: readability-gate
description: A Stop hook that checks the final message of each turn answers the owner in plain spoken English, using the talk-normal rules: the answer first, no names or numbers the owner has not seen, no report voice, and every decision explained. A failing message goes back for one rewrite. The same rules are added to Claude's context at session start. Fails open with a visible warning. Claude Code only. No MCP server, no skills.

hooks.statusMessage: Checking the reply reads without context...
